info.title: Lotse Console API
info.description: HTTP gateway and UI backend of lotse-console.

get.summary: Role bindings: all for a cluster admin, one's own for everyone else.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

get.summary:
The requests for client certificates, newest first, with the certificate
of each that was signed: every request for a cluster admin, the caller's
own for everyone else.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

post.summary:
Asks the CA holder for a client certificate: a cluster admin in any name,
everyone else in their own, where a new request replaces their pending
one. The body carries a signing request made in the browser: the private
key never reaches the console, and the CA holder signs with
`lotse certs --sign`.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

get.summary:
The client certificates the cluster has seen or had revoked, by expiry.
The broker lets only cluster admins list them.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

post.summary:
Revokes one client certificate, by issuer and serial. Every node refuses
it from then on and ends the connections that showed it. Destructive: the
body names the serial again.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

post.summary: Pins a partition's leader to one of its replicas, or unpins it.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

get.summary:
Chart history from the console's in-memory buffer (at most 180 points):
the sum over the streams and queues the caller may see; the commit
latency only for cluster admins and cluster viewers.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

get.summary: Nodes, rolling upgrade and operator events.

post.summary:
Places a partition's replicas on named nodes, or releases it to the
planner with no nodes (ADR 0115).

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.
The signed-in user may not do this.

409.description: A resource with this name exists.

post.summary:
Settles a queue's ready messages: what consumers hold stays theirs.
Destructive: the body names the queue again.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

post.summary:
Moves the ready messages of a dead-letter queue back to the queues they
came from, each once.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

post.summary:
Gives every partition of a stream or queue a number of replicas. Moves
four partitions at a time and releases placed partitions (ADR 0115).

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

get.summary:
The open client sessions on every node: all of them for a cluster admin
or viewer, the signed-in user's own otherwise (ADR 0121).

post.summary:
Ends the sessions of a user or an IdP group that began before now.
Destructive: the body names the subject again.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

get.summary: Reads records without joining a consumer group.
The access tokens of the signed-in user, or of `owner`. Never the text.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description:
A user whose tokens to list; only cluster admins and viewers may ask
for anyone but themselves.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

post.summary:
Makes an access token. The answer holds its text, the only time anyone
sees it: keep it out of logs and lists.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

409.description: The cluster does not take tokens yet.

post.summary:
Revokes an access token: the sessions it opened end and it is refused
from then on.
Stops the rolling upgrade after the node it is on.

post.summary:
Raises the cluster version to the newest every node runs with (ADR
0127): new formats come into use, and no node can go back to the
previous release.

400.description: Not every node runs with a newer version.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

get.summary: SCRAM users. The broker lets only cluster admins list them.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

post.summary: Creates a user with a credential the browser derived.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

delete.summary: Deletes a user. Destructive: the body names the user again.

403.description: The signed-in user may not do this.

put.summary: Sets a new password for a user, as a derived credential.

detail.description: What happened and what to do.

node.description: Node the alert is about, if any.

incoming.description: Partitions on their way to it.

Assignment.description: Who owns which partition in a group.

note.description: Explanation of a handover in progress.

BindingRow.description: A role binding with its tenant, prefix and where it comes from.

prefix.description: Name prefix the binding covers; empty means every name.

subject_kind.description: `user` or `group` (a group at the identity provider).

tenant.description: Tenant; empty for the two cluster-wide roles.

bindings.description:
Every binding the caller may see: all of them for a cluster admin,
the caller's own for everyone else.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may change bindings.

CertificateRequestRow.description: One request for a client certificate (ADR 0092).

certificate.description: The signed certificate, PEM; empty until signed.

expires_at_ms.description: When an unsigned request lapses, ms since the Unix epoch.

id.description: SHA-256 of the signing request, 64 hex digits.

key_fingerprint.description:
SHA-256 of the requester's public key, 64 hex digits: what
`lotse certs --sign` shows the CA holder, to compare with the key
the browser made. Empty if the request cannot be read.

principal.description: The principal the certificate will name.

requested_at_ms.description: When, ms since the Unix epoch.

signed_at_ms.description: When it was signed; 0 if not yet.

all.description:
Whether `requests` lists every request: the caller is a cluster
admin and may ask in any name.

bound_by_name.description:
Whether a role is bound to that name itself. A certificate signs in
without the identity provider's groups, so roles bound only to a
group do not come with it.

now_ms.description: The cluster's clock when the list was made, ms since the Unix epoch.

pending.description: Requests in the list that wait for the CA holder.

principal.description:
The name a certificate for the caller carries; empty if the caller
has none (not signed in as a user).

requests.description:
Newest first: every request for a cluster admin, the caller's own
for everyone else (ADR 0119).

CertificateRow.description: One client certificate the cluster has seen or had revoked (ADR 0091).

first_seen_ms.description: When a node first accepted it; 0 if none did.

issuer.description: SHA-256 of the issuer's DER name and authority key identifier (ADR 0096), 64 hex digits.

last_seen_ms.description:
When a node last accepted it; connections that stay open are noted
again every ten minutes and the cluster records it at most hourly.

not_after_ms.description: Millisecond it stops being valid in, since the Unix epoch.

not_before_ms.description: First millisecond it is valid in, since the Unix epoch; 0 if unknown.

principal.description: The principal it names; empty for one revoked before any node saw it.

reason.description: Why it was revoked; empty if it was not.

revoked_at_ms.description: When it was revoked; 0 if it was not.

now_ms.description: The cluster's clock when the list was made, ms since the Unix epoch.

Chip.description: A status chip: colour plus word, never colour alone.

text.description: Word shown next to the colour.

demo.description: `true` when served by the built-in demo cluster.

id.description: Cluster ID from the console config.

queue_options.description:
Whether queues can have priorities, single active consumer, a TTL
and dead-letter queues.

tenants.description: Whether the cluster has tenants (quotas, role bindings).

name.description: Name: lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens.

tenant.description: Tenant; required where the cluster has tenants, absent elsewhere.

CreateTokenBody.description: Request to make an access token (ADR 0133).

name.description: A label to tell the token by, 1 to 64 bytes.

owner.description:
The user it acts as; only a cluster admin may name someone but
themselves. Absent: the signed-in user.

CreateUser.description: Request to create a user with a credential.

CreatedTokenView.description:
A token just made. This answer is the only place its text exists: the
cluster keeps a hash, so nobody can show the text again.

expires_at.description: When it stops being valid, ms since the Unix epoch.

id.description: The token's id, to revoke it by.

text.description: The text to give to scripts and tools. Shown once.

Credential.description:
A SCRAM credential derived in the browser (ADR 0089). There is no
password field: the console never sees one.

iterations.description: PBKDF2 iterations; the broker refuses fewer than its minimum.

DeleteUser.description: Request to delete a user. Destructive: names the user again.

Done.description: Result of a write, with the CLI command that does the same.

ErrorBody.description: Error body for every failed request.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do.

Group.description: A consumer group reading a stream.

lag_trend.description: Lag samples over the last hour, oldest first.

HandoverEvent.description: An entry in the single-active-consumer handover log.

HealthItem.description: One line of the health list.

oneOf.description: Status chip, if the item has one.

Me.description: The signed-in user, as the cluster sees them.

MoveLeader.description:
Request to pin a partition's leader to one of its replicas, or to unpin
it (ADR 0065).

node.description:
The node to lead it, as the console names nodes; `None` unpins it so
that leaders spread by themselves again.

disk_free_bytes.description: Free bytes on the log volume.

disk_free_limit_bytes.description:
Below this much free space the groups the node votes in take no new
data (ADR 0122); 0 for no limit, `None` when the node did not say.

disk_low.description:
Whether the node is below its limit now; it is again above it only
once its free space is a tenth above the limit.

produce_bytes_per_sec.description: Client produce traffic into this node, bytes/s.

replicas.description: Raft groups with a replica on this node.

metadata_leader.description: Node that leads the metadata group.

last_stable.description: Below the first open transaction; `read_committed` stops here.

pinned.description: The node a cluster admin pinned its leader to (ADR 0065).

placed.description:
Placed on named nodes by a cluster admin (ADR 0115): rebalancing
and the replication factor leave it alone.

PlacePartition.description:
Request to place a partition's replicas on named nodes, or to release
it to the planner with no nodes (ADR 0115).

nodes.description: The nodes, as the console names them; empty releases the partition.

Point.description: One point of a time series.

PriorityLevel.description: A queue priority level (ADR 0078: levels share the queue's one log).

leader.description: Leader of the queue the level belongs to.

level.description: Level number; higher is delivered first.

oldest_ms.description: Age of the oldest ready message, ms.

PurgeQueue.description:
Request to purge a queue's ready messages (ADR 0064). Destructive, so
the queue's name must be typed again.

confirm.description: The queue's name, typed by the user.

principal.description: Principal; `null` while the cluster has no authentication.

binding.description: Exchange and binding key, if bound.

in_open_txns.description: Acks waiting for their transaction to commit.

levels_unread.description:
Ready messages whose level the queue's leader has not read yet: a
new leader reads the backlog for levels (ADR 0120).

pinned.description: The node a cluster admin pinned its leader to (ADR 0065).

placed.description: Placed on named nodes by a cluster admin (ADR 0115).

replicas.description: The nodes that hold the queue's replicas.

oneOf.description: Why the queue needs attention, if it does.

value.description: Value as UTF-8, if it is.

RecordView.description: A record read through the browser.

value.description: Value as UTF-8, if it is.

ReplicaState.description: Role of a replica in a Raft group.

RequestCertificate.description:
A request for a client certificate (ADR 0092). The browser made the key
and the signing request; the console never sees the private key.

csr.description: The PKCS#10 signing request, DER, base64.

principal.description:
The principal the certificate will name: letters, digits, `.`, `_`,
`-` and `@`.

RevokeCertificate.description:
Request to revoke one client certificate (ADR 0090). Destructive: the
serial is typed again.

issuer.description: SHA-256 of the issuer's DER name and authority key identifier (ADR 0096), 64 hex digits.

not_after_ms.description:
When the certificate stops being valid, ms since the Unix epoch. The
revocation is forgotten after that: an expired certificate is refused
anyway.

RevokeSessions.description:
Request to revoke the sessions of a user or an IdP group (ADR 0070).
Destructive: names the subject again.

group.description: `true` for a group at the identity provider.

auth.description:
How the subject is recognised: `user` or `group` (a group at the
identity provider); the demo says `mTLS` or `OIDC`.

SessionRow.description: One open client session on a node (ADR 0121).

connected_ms.description: When the connection was made, ms since the Unix epoch.

credential_ms.description:
When its credential dates from, ms since the Unix epoch; a session
revocation after it ends the session.

expires_ms.description:
When it ends unless renewed, ms since the Unix epoch; none for one
that lasts as long as its connection.

groups.description: Groups at the identity provider (OAUTHBEARER only).

node.description: The node that holds the connection.

peer.description: The other end's address as the node sees it.

principal.description: Who it acts as: a user's name, a node's name, or `anonymous`.

SessionsView.description:
The open client sessions the signed-in user may see: every session for
a cluster admin or viewer, their own otherwise (ADR 0121).

everyone.description: Whether the user sees every session or only their own.

sessions.description: The sessions, by node and then oldest first.

SetReplication.description:
Request to give every partition of a stream or queue a number of
replicas (`replication.factor`, ADR 0115). Releases its placed
partitions.

factor.description: Replicas per partition, from 1 to the active nodes.

oneOf.description: Assignment of the group the UI highlights.

oldest_record_age_ms.description: Age of the oldest record, ms.

open_transactions.description:
Open transactions, summed over the stream's partitions: a
transaction that writes to two partitions counts in each.

oneOf.description: What the stream keeps; `None` when the cluster did not say.

StreamRetention.description: How long and how much a stream keeps.

bytes.description: Each partition keeps about this many bytes; `None`: no limit by size.

ms.description: Records older than this many milliseconds go; `None`: no limit by age.

quota_bytes.description: Storage quota, bytes; `None` where the cluster has no quotas.

commit_p99_ms.description:
p99 time until a produce is acknowledged by a quorum, ms; `null`
without produces to measure.

TokenRow.description:
One access token as it is listed (ADR 0133): what the cluster keeps,
which is never the secret.

created_at.description: When it was made, ms since the Unix epoch.

created_by.description: Who made it: the owner, or a cluster admin.

expires_at.description: When it stops being valid, ms since the Unix epoch.

TokensView.description:
The access tokens the signed-in user may see: their own, or with an
owner named and the role for it, that user's.

tokens.description: The tokens still valid, oldest first.

Tone.description: Health of something, as the UI colours it.

TxnState.description: Transaction state of a record as a reader sees it.

Upgrade.description:
A rolling upgrade (ADR 0127): run by the operator, or node by node
with the cluster's restart turn.

cluster_version.description:
The cluster version in force, `major.minor`: the formats every node
writes.

groups_catching_up.description: Raft groups still catching up on the current node.

paused_after_current.description:
`true` once the upgrade stops after the current node: restart turns
are paused.

raise_to.description:
A newer cluster version every node runs with, which a cluster admin
may raise it to; `None` while some node does not.

steps.description: Steps, one per node in upgrade order.

UpgradePhase.description: A phase of upgrading one node.

UpgradeStep.description: One node's progress through a rolling upgrade.

phases.description: Phases in order, with their state.

UserRow.description:
A SCRAM user. Key material never leaves the cluster, so a row says only
how the user is stored.

iterations.description: PBKDF2 iterations of the stored credential.

name.description: User name, the principal in role bindings.

roles.description: Bindings that name this user, as `role (tenant)` texts.
